parameters.name: CipherSuite
parameters.description:
The type of the cipher suites. Valid values:

*   **1**: all cipher suites.
*   **2**: strong cipher suites.
*   **99**: custom cipher suites.

parameters.name: CustomCiphers
parameters.description: The custom cipher suites that you want to add. This parameter is available only if you set **CipherSuite** to **99**.

parameters.name: EnableTLSv3
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to support TLS 1.3. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: TLSVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the TLS protocol. Valid values:

*   **tlsv1**
*   **tlsv1.1**
*   **tlsv1.2**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-default-https --cert-id 123-cn-hangzhou --tls-version tlsv1 --cipher-suite 0 --custom-ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --enable-tlsv3 true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyDefaultHttps --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --CustomCiphers.1 'ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384' --TLSVersion tlsv1 --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-000' --CertId '123-cn-hangzhou' --CipherSuite 0 --EnableTLSv3 true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
